answer: In this design, each identity must complete a prescribed chain of modular squarings, with every step depending on the previous result; a Wesolowski proof lets verifiers check the output efficiently. An attacker may run clone chains on separate GPUs, but cannot parallelize the steps within a chain to shorten its elapsed time, so each clone incurs a physical delay. The lotus, delta, and gale parameters can distinguish challenges without removing this sequential bottleneck.
